name: BNL-E-0734
summary: BNL E734 was a fine-grained neutrino detector designed for elastic neutral-current and charged-current reactions around the GeV scale, including neutrino-electron and neutrino-proton scattering.
physics_targets: Weak neutral-current couplings and the weak mixing angle
Nucleon axial and strange form factors
detection_principle: A highly active, segmented target used liquid scintillator and proportional drift tubes to reconstruct recoil protons, muons and electron showers. A downstream calorimeter and muon system helped identify final states and reject inelastic backgrounds.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: Historical apparatus and published data are documented by the cited experiment publications.

Neutrino-proton and antineutrino-proton elastic results published

results.summary: Published differential elastic cross sections and an axial-vector form-factor measurement consistent with the electroweak Standard Model within the reported uncertainties.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
